g.text: JpnI (2007~), JRA GI (1984~2007), NAR GI (1997~2007), other domestic G1 (e.g. HK G1)
JpnII (2007~), JRA GII (1984~2007), NAR GII (1997~2007), other domestic G2 (e.g. HK G2)
JpnIII (2007~), JRA GIII (1984~2007), NAR GIII (1997~2007), other domestic G3 (e.g. HK G3)
Important races designated '重賞', at local/regional level or before grading was introduced
Alternate Triple Crown Race (JPN dirt/USA turf)
Flags indicate that primary training centre is outside Japan.
Races under a flag should be assumed to be in that country
Background = horse age during that period
Name in game is different from name in real life; placeholder name exists
Is NPC in-game (in supporting characters roster)
Flags above name indicate country foaled. If there is no flag, the horse was foaled
